scope.authority: Only actual finished maintained dense F64 binder branches attach the private scalar certificate. Exact scalar FloatingPoint(W64) schema, empty dimensions/shape and genuine dense F64 layout are checked. Final private seal remains bound to exact request and BoundCall; names, public work tags and public primitive enums grant no semantics.
scope.contracts: Only I64Neg, F64Neg and F64Sqrt admit maintained SameAsInput0. All other certified operations retain Declared FullWrite. Pure ReadSignal/WriteSignal, no alias and ExactScalar are still required.
scope.sqrt: Certifies only dense bind_unary_f64 with square_root=f64::sqrt. The existing alternate Snapshot/libm square_root_f32 path remains selectable for resident execution but is not certified.
scope.ieee: Ordinary Cranelift F64 operations with optimizer disabled, NaN canonicalization explicitly disabled, no fast-math, reassociation or FMA. Ordered Lets are preserved. Numeric comparisons use IEEE unordered behavior for != and ordered behavior for < <= > >=. Division by zero and nonfinite values retain floating behavior rather than integer Arithmetic guards.
scope.transport: Encode/decode uses F64Bits bits/from_bits and actual eight-byte transport. All 64-bit patterns are accepted, including nonfinite and signed NaN payloads. Setup, per-Let, completion, finite frame/work limits and staged atomic output publication use the same real managed runtime as JIT and linked entry.
scope.identity: Typed IR identity version3 appends kind/value tag4 and op tags30..41. Existing tags remain. C ABI1 and work policy1 remain because physical record/lane layout is unchanged. Raw bits are encoded explicitly, never Debug formatting.
scope.generated_shell: F64 input/output uses exact f64: followed by 16 ASCII hex digits. It accepts every valid raw bit pattern and rejects malformed transport spelling. Decimal/NaN text is not the binary-preserving protocol.
scope.native_memory: NativeHost uses actual FunctionValueRepresentation::F64 with Float(W64) physical storage. Bool semantic storage and eight-byte ABI backing remain distinct.
scope.admission: Each primitive retains the documented finite per-Let256 bound and actual emitted CLIF instruction delta plus fixed64 callback bound. Metadata compilation remains outside evaluation. No extra per-call full-plan clone or unadmitted transport traversal is introduced.

bit_corpus.coverage: Signed zeros, smallest/largest subnormal and minimum normal, rounding-sensitive values, finite overflow, infinities, multiple quiet/signaling signed NaN payloads in both operand positions. Expected arithmetic bits come from the actual resident implementation, not an invented corpus oracle.

tests.metadata: All12 operations original and decoded, genuine NativeHost F64/Bool storage, direct constants/output forwarding, dead IEEE node order, exact dense vs Snapshot/libm certification and private contract/mutation negatives. Rem/pow/F32/matrix/Activation/state/Match reject; public RuntimeMetered replacement cannot certify.
tests.runtime: Original/decoded actual resident vs JIT bitwise arithmetic/unary results; numeric comparisons; no-FMA and no-reassociation discriminators; dead IEEE computation retained; earlier checked U64 error precedes later F64 and later denial. Setup/completion/memory/shared-budget/type denial leaves outputs unchanged, then same compiled instance recovers.
tests.object: Emission-only case explicitly reports linked=false, executed=false and timing_samples=0.

linked_extension.description: Fourth program retains identity plus all12 operations; original and decoded actual resident/JIT typed references, exact raw-bit stdout/errors/node/phase and unchanged binary/object/IR/bytecode/source pins. Original three build-once program suites remain.

tests.retained_fixture_updates: Two former F64-negative source cases become F32-negative now that F64 is actually supported. Existing typed reference helpers become exhaustive for the new F64 variant.

composition: Incremental after I64. Preserve committed local-dependency and runtime-only generator corrections; frozen F64 source does not supply them. Raw-bit differential checks remain unrun.
